body.name: Zhang observational PAG
body.construction: For each \(e\in\mathcal E_0(\mathcal O_0)\), set \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm Z}(\mathcal O_0)(e)=m\) if \(\nu_M(e)=m\in\{\mathtt{tail},\mathtt{arrow}\}\) for every \(M\in\mathcal C_{\mathrm{MAG}}(\mathcal O_0)\), and set \(\mathcal P_{\mathrm Z}(\mathcal O_0)(e)=\mathtt{circle}\) otherwise.
